content.value: The first time you open the Passive Tree, you must select a class. Selection grants the class's base attributes and unlocks its starting node without spending a point. It also fixes where your connected route begins.

15 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at the Armour route. Best fit for heavy armour, maximum health, and close-range physical weapons.

7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 15 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at [[stat/cranks-dungeons:evasion_rating|Evasion Rating]]. Best fit for bows, fast attacks, critical strikes, and avoiding entity-sourced hits.

11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at Armour and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:evasion_rating|Evasion Rating]]. A physical hybrid suited to swords, spears, crossbows, and mixed defensive bases.

7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:evasion_rating|Evasion Rating]]. A mobile hybrid that combines avoidance with a rechargeable buffer.

7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 15 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]]. Best fit for mana, elemental damage, ailments, and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]-aligned defence.

11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:strength|Strength]], 7 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:dexterity|Dexterity]], 11 [[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]]. Starts at Armour and [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]]. A durable hybrid for physical pressure, recovery, and layered mitigation.
A class is a starting position, not a locked job. Connected routes can eventually travel toward other archetypes if you invest enough points.
